about.title: About
about.metaTitle: About Tony Hoang - Practical AI for Vietnamese professionals
about.metaDescription: Learn how Tony Hoang tests and shares practical AI workflows for real work.
about.heroIntro: I help Vietnamese professionals turn AI from a vague idea into workflows they can use for work, marketing, and digital products.
about.storyP1: I came to AI with a practical question: how can I solve work faster while still understanding the process, instead of chasing every new tool?
about.storyP2: Through learning and testing, I found that value does not come from knowing the most tools. It comes from breaking down the problem, providing the right context, and designing a repeatable workflow.
about.storyP3: That is why I turn what I test into guides, learning paths, and free courses. The goal is not only to show what AI can do, but to help you build something useful yourself.
about.value1Desc: Everything complex can be explained simply. I believe anyone can learn.
about.value2Desc: Technology changes fast, so I always keep learning to bring the latest knowledge.
about.value3Desc: No empty theory. Every piece of knowledge is tied to immediate real-world application.
about.value4Desc: Everyone has their own learning pace. I don't rush — you just need to be ready to start.
about.infoCollaboration: Open for collaboration and teaching opportunities
about.ctaSubtitle: Ready to start your journey with AI? I'll be with you every step of the way.
